hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk slabs are cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible across the foreground and midground sidewalk area.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated in the middle of the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective clear walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of marked crosswalks or pedestrian-oriented signage along the residential block.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway surface

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway width requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for the full crossing duration without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: The marked zebra crosswalk at the intersection.

hazards.name: Obstructed Sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles are positioned in the middle of the narrow sidewalk, reducing the clear path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street obscures sightlines between pedestrians (especially children) and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view

hazards.name: Narrow sidewalk with obstructions
hazards.description: Building steps and parked cars encroach on the narrow walkway, creating a constrained path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the image where the sidewalk meets the houses and parked cars.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: The red and black cars parked along the curb.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the distance spent in the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to clearly designate pedestrian priority areas.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening and night hours.
